decision_ledger.action: Describe every failure cause and pre-existing push/phase diagnostics; no exclusions, no primary changes, no new superiority test

limitations: Same-operator independent CPU arithmetic, not new seeds or second reviewer.
Failure reasons overlap; they are descriptions, not identified causal mechanisms.
Push recovery rates retain all assigned episodes; conditional exposed/latency summaries suffer survival selection.
Phase cycle summaries require >=3 complete contact cycles; coverage and each seed are reported. Contact chatter and survival can affect them.
Frequency association does not establish beneficial adaptation or causal robustness.
